semiconductor_relevance: High — Hiroshima University Semiconductor Engineering Laboratory focuses on advanced temperature measurement technologies critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Hiroshima University Semiconductor Engineering Laboratory conducts research and education on semiconductor processes and devices, showcasing innovative technologies such as Optical Interference Contactless Thermometry (OICT). This high-precision, non-contact temperature measurement method is essential for monitoring wafer temperatures during various semiconductor processes, enhancing yield management and product traceability.
capabilities: Non-contact temperature measurement during plasma processes
